points.description: The student explains that heat transfers from the hot object (tea) to the colder surroundings (environment/air).

rubric.notes: Full marks are awarded for mentioning the transfer of heat from the hot object to the surroundings. No marks are awarded if the answer does not mention heat transfer or incorrectly states the direction of heat flow.
rubric.answer_key: उष्णता गरम चहाच्या कपाकडून सभोवतालच्या थंड हवेकडे संक्रमित होते, म्हणून चहा थंड होतो.
